structure.unit: Fisheries and Habitat of the Tidal Waters
Fishing for Oysters and Clams; Device Restrictions

law.catch_line: Possession of oysters while taking clams; penalty
law.text: The possession of oysters while taking or catching clams during the season in which it is unlawful to take or catch oysters from the public rocks, beds, or shoals, is prima facie evidence of a violation of the law against taking or catching oysters during the prohibited season. A violation of this section is a Class 1 misdemeanor.
